az-county-officials.summary: The County card names the county you picked, and not its supervisors or other elected officers. The card says so rather than leave the office looking empty.
az-county-officials.why: No statewide list of Arizona's county officials has been read for this app yet, and the counties' own pages have not been read one by one.
az-county-officials.wanted: One statewide list of each county's supervisors and other elected officers, or a county's own published list of them.

az-municipal-officeholders.summary: The City or Town card names the city or town you picked, and not its mayor or council members.
az-municipal-officeholders.why: No statewide list of the elected officials of Arizona's cities and towns has been read for this app, and their own pages have not been read one by one.
az-municipal-officeholders.wanted: One statewide list of each city's and town's mayor and council members, or a city's or town's own published list of them.

az-school-board-members.summary: The three School District cards name the districts you picked, and not the members of their governing boards.
az-school-board-members.why: No list of the governing board members of Arizona's school districts has been read for this app, and the districts' own pages have not been read one by one.
az-school-board-members.wanted: One statewide list of each school district's governing board members, or a district's own published list of its board.

az-tribal-government.summary: The Tribal Government card names the council of 15 of Arizona's 21 nations, from each nation's own page. For each of the other six it says why it names nobody.
az-tribal-government.why: One of those nations' pages names only its two top officers, and a council is carried only where its page names all its seats or all but one. The others refused this project, could not be read, name nobody, or have no site.
az-tribal-government.wanted: A council list from each of the other six nations that this project may read, naming every member.
